sara: quick nsys capture to isolate KV-evict hotspot. short run (30s) using trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt — timeline has big OSRT idle bands making kernel hotspoting noisy. qdrep: /tmp/nsys_kv_short.qdrep

mike: can you paste the exact CLI?

sara: ```bash
nsys profile \
  --output /tmp/nsys_kv_short \
  --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt \
  --sample=cpu \
  --duration=30 \
  --capture-range=nvtx \
  python -m myruntime.run_load --batch-size 16 --seq 1024
```

andrew: osrt events look like long blocks when sampling window or capture cadence is coarse. try lowering sampling or disable osrt to get a cleaner CUDA-only timeline.

sara: reduced sample to 100us and trimmed to 12s; re-ran. matmul kernel still chosen is generic variant for >512 tokens, causing KV cache churn. timeline shows a few ~ms matmul launches + lots of small memcpy_asyncs (KV handoff).

mike: what kernel names are showing up in the hotspot?

sara: common hits: cuLaunchKernel -> matmul_ogemm_fp16, matmul_kflex_fp16, memcpy_async, cudaMemcpyAsync, small reduction kernels. lots of kernel_launch_latency spikes around KV evict windows.

perf-bot: Perf regression alert: rollout "2026-03-10-optimized-kernels" increased matmul latency by ~12% on A100 in nightly perf. See CI run 2026-03-11.

andrew: we should force the kflex variant to validate selector logic: export KERNEL_SELECTOR=force_kflex then re-run. also test without OSRT: `--trace=cuda,nvtx` to reduce user-space scheduling noise.

sara: also toggled KV_CACHE_PREFETCH=0 on the test binary — eviction bursts reduced noticeably. planning longer baseline (120s) without osrt to get steady-state behavior.

mike: for long runs use bracketed capture to avoid warmup jitter: `--capture-range=bracketed --start-after 5s --stop-after 110s`. and pipe qdrep -> sqim or report to isolate per-kernel p50/p95.

sara: good tips, will run forced-kflex + KV_PREFETCH off + cuda-only trace for 120s and share qdrep. TL;DR: short nsys+osrt is useful for NVTX context but creates noisy idle bands for kernel-level hotpots; lower sampling or disable OSRT for clean CUDA kernel timelines. KV prefetch knob materially affects eviction patterns. :thumbsup:
